name: smwsprites-anti-starman
title: Anti-Starman
description:
This Star works like the original, but it Will damage or kill the player if touch her. There are a bit of settings and defines that can be change in the .asm like:

1.- Tilemap.
2.- Flash Animation.
3.- X/Y Speed to change the arc.

This Sprite is based in the SMW Star dissamble Made by RussianMan, Credit is optional, but it's would be nice.

There are two examples .gif to see how this sprite works and a one screenshot :)

This Sprite was requested by Anorakun
